integrity: Self-contained algebraic derivation supplemented by two reproducible finite checks; inherited projective incidence identities and Desarguesian code-rank formula are attributed to literature. Tests do not substitute for unrestricted proof.
limitations: Finite projective planes of order at least two, characteristic-two finite-field wave update. The results give the entire periodic-point census in terms of the binary point-line incidence rank; they do not classify the available ranks among non-Desarguesian planes or imply wave-system isomorphism. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
title: The incidence-rank clock of reversible waves on finite projective planes
